subject: Bug in dsm.cor in package dsm?

messages.author: 512996ea4ff0ea65
messages.subject: Bug in dsm.cor in package dsm?
parts:
Calling dsm.cor I get the following error message

Error in dsm.cor(mod3Fxy.bn.k10, max.lag = 10) : 
  No column called Segment.Label in data


Supposedly segment data data must have "Sample.Label" as the head for the segment data...that is how I run the modelling and worked fine.

Suggestions?

Many thanks

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Bug in dsm.cor in package dsm?
parts:
Dear Adrian and listfolk,

You can set the Segment.Label argument to a string that gives the same
of the column with the segment identifiers in them. The default is
"Segment.Label".

The example given in ?dsm.cor illustrates this for the model of Gulf of
Mexico dolphin data:

library(Distance)
library(dsm)
data(mexdolphins)
hr.model <- ds(mexdolphins$distdata, max(mexdolphins$distdata$distance),
key = "hr", adjustment = NULL)
mod1<-dsm(N~s(x,y), hr.model, mexdolphins$segdata, mexdolphins$obsdata)


dsm.cor(mod1, resid.type="d", max.lag=9, Segment.Label="Sample.Label")


Hope this helps!

best,
--dave
